title: TCP Three-Way Handshake and Connection Teardown
prompt: Generate a sequence diagram of the TCP three-way handshake and connection teardown process.
mermaid_code:
sequenceDiagram

tcpClient->>tcpServer: SYN
	tcpServer-->>tcpClient: SYN-ACK

tcpClient-->>tcpServer: ACK
	tcpServer-->>tcpClient: ACK

	tcpClient-->>tcpServer: FIN
		tcpServer-->>tcpClient: FIN-ACK

tcpClient-->>tcpServer: CLOSE
		tcpServer-->>tcpClient: CLOSE-ACK

tcpClient-->>tcpServer: ACK
		tcpServer-->>tcpClient: ACK

		tcpClient-->>tcpServer: FIN
			tcpServer-->>tcpClient: FIN-ACK
			tcpClient-->>tcpServer: ACK

			tcpServer-->>tcpClient: ACK
			tcpClient-->>tcpServer: CLOSE
				tcpServer-->>tcpClient: CLOSE-ACK
				tcpClient-->>tcpServer: ACK
explanation: This sequence diagram illustrates the TCP three-way handshake and connection teardown process. The diagram shows the interaction between a client and a server to establish a connection and the subsequent termination of the connection. Key components include the client sending a SYN packet, the server responding with a SYN-ACK, and the client sending an ACK to complete the handshake. The teardown process involves the client closing the connection and the server acknowledging the closure.
